tagline: The world's largest primary silver producer and Mexico's largest gold producer
hero_kpi_rationale: Core activity of the mining group, record silver production reflecting operational excellence and market-leading position as the world's largest primary silver producer.

kpis.name: Silver Production
kpis.explanation: Quantity of silver produced annually by the company, in millions of ounces.
kpis.description: Silver production increased in 2024, driven by improved operational performance across multiple sites.

kpis.name: Gold Production
kpis.explanation: Quantity of gold produced annually by the company, in thousands of ounces.
kpis.description: Gold production advanced in 2024 thanks to improved recovery rates at Ciénega and Herradura.

kpis.name: All-in Sustaining Costs
kpis.explanation: Total cost to produce one ounce of silver, including maintenance and exploration expenses.
kpis.description: All-in sustaining costs declined in 2024 despite input inflation, due to efficiency gains.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of precious metals.
kpis.description: Revenue increased in 2024 due to higher sales volumes and sustained silver and gold prices.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by volumes and prices

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin improved in 2024 thanks to better productivity and rigorous cost management.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investment expenditures to maintain and develop mining operations.
kpis.description: CAPEX increased in 2024 to fund expansion and exploration projects, notably at Juanicipio and Orisyvo.
kpis.signal: CAPEX up to support future growth

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share distributed annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 79.7486 GBp in the last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.654 bn GBp in the last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 47.2% in the last year.

ai_positioning.summary: Fresnillo plc does not mention any AI strategy or initiatives in its recent financial or operational documents.
evidence: No AI mention in the 2024 annual report
No references to AI-based predictive analytics or automation tools
Absence of partnerships or investments in mining AI technologies
